noun_definition: Place name refers to the specific name of a location that should be displayed alongside the address for suggestions and recent waypoints in the application, similar to how it is presented in Google and Apple Maps.
Address refers to the specific location details that should be displayed alongside place names for suggestions and recent waypoints, similar to how they are presented in Google and Apple Maps.
Suggestion refers to a proposed place name and address that should be displayed for recent waypoints, similar to the functionality in Google and Apple Maps.
Waypoint refers to a specific location that is suggested or recently visited, similar to features in Google and Apple Maps.
google refers to a mapping service that provides place names and addresses for suggestions and recent waypoints, similar to other mapping applications like Apple Maps.
apple refers to a mapping service or application that provides location suggestions and waypoints, similar to Google Maps.
maps refers to digital navigation tools that display place names and addresses, similar to those provided by Google and Apple.
